basic_details.job_title: DPSRU Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 3 Lab Technician, Junior Research Fellow and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Research Associate-I, Lab Technician, Junior Research Fellow
basic_details.short_information: Delhi Pharmaceutical Science and Research University (DPSRU), New Delhi, has invited applications for 3 posts in 3 roles. The posts include Research Associate-I, Lab Technician, Junior Research Fellow. Selection is through a walk-in interview on 30 October 2026.

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Varies by post - see the table below
age_limit.details: Age is counted on date of interview. | Age relaxation for all posts: SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Female 5 years.

qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D in Biotechnology/Molecular Biology/Pharmacology or Bachelor/Post Graduate degree in Science/Pharmacy/Biotechnology

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Ph. D in Biotechnology /Molecular Biology/ Pharmacology with 1 Years of research experience of gene sequencing with Next Generation sequencing equipment or Proficiency in Precision Medicine. Experience required: 1 Years of research experience of gene sequencing with Next Generation sequencing equipment. Age limit: Maximum 40 years. Pay: Rs. 50,000 (Consolidated). Qualification required: Bachelor degree in Science /DMLT/D. Pharm with TWO years’ experience in the Hospital/Research Organization/Industry or Post Graduate degree in Science. Experience required: TWO years’ experience in the Hospital/Research Organization/Industry. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Rs. 35,000 (Consolidated). Qualification required: First Class Bachelor degree in Pharmacy (B. Pharm)/ B. Tec

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 50,000, depending on the post

how_to_apply: Bring the filled-in application form along with one set of self-attested photocopies of certificates and testimonials.
Bring all original documents for verification at the interview venue.
Attend on 30 October 2026, reporting at 9:00 AM.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in-interview.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Consolidated emoluments, taxable as per norms. Temporary/contractual nature for 11 months, which can be continued for maximum of 3 terms on the basis of performance.

content_sections.text: Bring the filled-in application form along with one set of self-attested photocopies of certificates and testimonials. Bring all original documents for verification at the interview venue. Attend on 30 October 2026, reporting at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for DPSRU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30 October 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DPSRU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Research Associate-I, 1 Lab Technician, 1 Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DPSRU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 30 October 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Auditorium, DPSRU Campus, Pushp Vihar, Sector-III, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Research Associate-I: maximum 40 years; Lab Technician: maximum 35 years; Junior Research Fellow: maximum 35 years. Relaxation: SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Female 5 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 50,000 (Consolidated) for Research Associate-I, Rs. 35,000 (Consolidated) for Lab Technician, Rs. 30,000 (Consolidated) for Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q8. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ph.D in Biotechnology/Molecular Biology/Pharmacology or Bachelor/Post Graduate degree in Science/Pharmacy/Biotechnology. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q9. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Manpower in projects are not entitled to DA and CCA. Remuneration is taxable as per norms.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Document verification before interview. Walk-in-interview. Walk-in-interview will be conducted purely on a temporary basis.
